title: Multiply Strings
keyIdea: Grade-school multiplication with a result array of m + n places. num1[i] × num2[j] contributes to place i + j + 1. Add it there, keep the ones digit, and push the tens to place i + j. Strip leading zeros at the end.

approaches.name: Grade-school with a position array
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). pos(m + n); for i, j from the right: sum = num1[i] × num2[j] + pos[i + j + 1]; pos[i + j + 1] = sum % 10; pos[i + j] += sum / 10; build the string skipping leading zeros.
approaches.why: Every digit pair once; the result has at most m + n digits.

quiz.q: Why does the product fit in m + n digits?
options: num1 < 10^m and num2 < 10^n, so the product < 10^(m + n)

quiz.q: num1[i] × num2[j] goes to which place?
options: i + j + 1 (with the carry going to i + j)
